c: BFCD2000-AD keeps the properties of its predecessor, while gaining a separate Glaive Beam attack that summons a pillar of light with large glaives orbiting within it, appearing from the bottom of the screen and making their way upwards while shredding enemies in their path.
The Glaive Beam activates independently of regular attacks, its chance of appearing relying on

- the higher it is, the more frequently the attack happens. When activated, massive Glaives will spiral upwards, dealing damage to any enemies they come in contact with, lasting until all the glaives are gone. These Glaives are capable of dealing critical damage with a x10 multiplier.

BFC2000-AD glaives have much lower knockback compared to
, as such evolving it should be a priority if you do not wish to compensate for the knockback with weapons that can freeze or otherwise hold enemies in place.
Since luck increases both the chance of activation and critical hits, it is an extremely important stat to scale up if going for this evolution.
When activating multiple times in short succession, Glaive Beams will stack their durations instead of overlapping, leading to potentially long periods of having the beam active.
can be a good way to help the beam reach a point where it will constantly be active.
